from_speaker: somewhere in the region of $30 billion
our_interpretation: This concerns the projection OpenAI held when the post appeared, not whether its eventual revenue met that projection.

‘In the region of’ permits ordinary approximation, but supplies no numerical tolerance.
criteria.support_condition: Accessible reporting or company documents establish a current projection reasonably described as approximately $30 billion of actual calendar-year 2026 revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that the current projection was materially different from approximately $30 billion.
